verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims 'AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments' within its bill pay product, which maps to AI reading bills and populating payment details. An approval flow is also mentioned, which covers the review step. The support is only a single marketing line, with no docs describing extraction of the invoice fields, how payment details are populated, or the review UI. Missing for 10: documentation of AI bill/invoice data extraction (vendor, amount, due date, bank details), description of the human review/edit step before payment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
